findings.title: Generate the queued timestamp per AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when the module is imported, so every AssignmentSource created without an explicit `queued` value gets the same process-start timestamp, rather than the time of its assignment. Long-running webhook workers will consequently serialize stale, identical queue times for unrelated changes. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to generate the timestamp for each instance.
